name: Anders Larsson
bio:
Anders Larsson's journey into the world of motorsport finance began unexpectedly after a career in corporate accounting. While working for a logistics company, he noticed irregularities in the financials of a motorsport team they sponsored. Intrigued, he approached the team, offering his services to streamline their budgeting and financial reporting. His meticulous approach and ability to identify cost-saving opportunities quickly made him an invaluable asset. 

He joined ART Grand Prix Academy five years ago, bringing a level of financial discipline that has allowed the team to invest strategically in research and development. Anders is known for his data-driven decision-making and his insistence on transparency in all financial matters. He believes that a solid financial foundation is crucial for any team aiming for success on the track.

What sets Anders apart is his ability to translate complex financial data into easily understandable terms for the engineers and drivers. He holds regular workshops to educate team members on the financial impact of their decisions, fostering a culture of shared responsibility and fiscal awareness within the team.

physical.description: Anders is a man of medium height with a slightly receding hairline and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small calculator, even to meetings.
Insists on using spreadsheets for everything, even when simpler tools would suffice.
Has a collection of vintage adding machines at home.
